children.name: openid-config
children.description:
Add one or more of these elements to specify a compliant OpenID configuration endpoint (url attribute) from which signing keys and issuer can be obtained.

Optionally, set validate-connectivity attribute to false to disable check of endpoint availability if URL can't be resolved via public DNS.

Configuration including the JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) is pulled from the endpoint every 1 hour and cached. If the token being validated references a validation key (using kid claim) that is missing in cached configuration, or if retrieval fails, API Management pulls from the endpoint at most once per 5 min. These intervals are subject to change without notice.

The response should be according to specs as defined at URL: https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-discovery-1_0.html#ProviderMetadata.

For Microsoft Entra ID use the OpenID Connect metadata endpoint configured in your app registration such as:
- v2 https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant-name}/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration
- v2 Multi-Tenant https://login.microsoftonline.com/organizations/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration
- v1 https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant-name}/.well-known/openid-configuration
- Customer tenant (preview) https://{tenant-name}.ciamlogin.com/{tenant-id}/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration

Substituting your directory tenant name or ID, for example contoso.onmicrosoft.com, for {tenant-name}.

children.name: issuer-signing-keys
children.description:
A list of Base64-encoded security keys, in key subelements, used to validate signed tokens. If multiple security keys are present, then each key is tried until either all are exhausted (in which case validation fails) or one succeeds (useful for token rollover).

Optionally, specify a key by using the id attribute to match the token's kid claim. To validate a token signed with an asymmetric key, optionally specify the public key using a certificate-id attribute with value set to the identifier of a certificate uploaded to API Management, or the RSA modulus n and exponent e pair of the signing key in Base64url-encoded format.

attributes.name: certificate-id

attributes.name: n

attributes.name: e
attributes.description: (Issuer signing key only) Exponent of the public key used to verify the issuer of a token signed with an asymmetric key. Must be specified with the value of the modulus n. Policy expressions aren't allowed.

children.name: decryption-keys
children.description:
A list of Base64-encoded keys, in key subelements, used to decrypt the tokens. If multiple security keys are present, then each key is tried until either all keys are exhausted (in which case validation fails) or a key succeeds.

To decrypt a token encrypted with an asymmetric key, optionally specify the public key using a certificate-id attribute with value set to the identifier of a certificate uploaded to API Management.

attributes.name: e

- any - at least one claim value must be present in the token for validation to succeed.

policies.name: choose
policies.description: Conditionally applies policy statements based on the results of the evaluation of Boolean expressions.

element.name: choose
element.description: Conditionally applies policy statements based on the results of the evaluation of Boolean expressions.

children.name: when
children.description: One or more elements specifying the if or ifelse parts of the choose policy. If multiple when elements are specified, they are evaluated sequentially. Once the condition of a when element evaluates to true, no further when conditions are evaluated.

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: The Boolean expression or Boolean constant to be evaluated when the containing when policy statement is evaluated.

children.name: otherwise
children.description: The policy snippet to be evaluated if none of the when conditions evaluate to true.

attributes.name: fragment-id
attributes.description: A string. Specifies the identifier (name) of a policy fragment created in the API Management instance. Policy expressions aren't allowed.

policies.name: retry
policies.description: Retries execution of the enclosed policy statements, if and until the condition is met.

element.name: retry
element.description: Retries execution of the enclosed policy statements, if and until the condition is met.

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: Boolean. Specifies whether retries should be stopped (false) or continued (true). Policy expressions are allowed.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: A positive number between 1 and 50 specifying the number of retries to attempt. Policy expressions are allowed.

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: A positive number in seconds specifying the wait interval between the retry attempts. Policy expressions are allowed.

attributes.name: max-interval
attributes.description: A positive number in seconds specifying the maximum wait interval between the retry attempts. It is used to implement an exponential retry algorithm. Policy expressions are allowed.

attributes.name: delta
attributes.description: A positive number in seconds specifying the wait interval increment. It is used to implement the linear and exponential retry algorithms. Policy expressions are allowed.

attributes.name: first-fast-retry
attributes.description: Boolean. If set to true, the first retry attempt is performed immediately. Policy expressions are allowed.

policies.name: wait
policies.description: Waits for enclosed Send request, Get value from cache, or Control flow policies to complete before proceeding.

element.name: wait
element.description: Waits for enclosed Send request, Get value from cache, or Control flow policies to complete before proceeding.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description:
Determines whether the wait policy waits for all immediate child policies to be completed or just one. Allowed values are:

- all - wait for all immediate child policies to complete
- any - wait for any immediate child policy to complete. Once the first immediate child policy has completed, the wait policy completes and execution of any other immediate child policies is terminated.

Policy expressions are allowed.

policies.description: Sends metrics to Application Insights for consumption of large language model (LLM) tokens through LLM APIs.

element.name: azure-openai-emit-token-metric
element.description: Sends metrics to Application Insights for consumption of large language model (LLM) tokens through LLM APIs.

attributes.name: namespace
attributes.description: A string. Namespace of metric. Policy expressions aren't allowed.

children.name: dimension
children.description: Add one or more of these elements for each dimension included in the metric.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: A string or policy expression. Name of dimension.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: A string or policy expression. Value of dimension. Can only be omitted if name matches one of the default dimensions. If so, value is provided as per dimension name.

policies.name: azure-openai-semantic-cache-lookup
policies.description: Performs lookup in large language model API cache using semantic search and returns a valid cached response when available.

element.name: azure-openai-semantic-cache-lookup
element.description: Performs lookup in large language model API cache using semantic search and returns a valid cached response when available.

attributes.name: score-threshold
attributes.description: Score threshold defines how closely an incoming prompt must match a cached prompt to return its stored response. The value ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. Lower values require higher semantic similarity for a match. Learn more.

attributes.name: embeddings-backend-id
attributes.description: Backend ID for embeddings API call.

attributes.name: embeddings-backend-auth
attributes.description: Authentication used for embeddings API backend.

attributes.name: ignore-system-messages
attributes.description: Boolean. When set to true (recommended), removes system messages from a chat completion prompt before assessing cache similarity.

attributes.name: max-message-count
attributes.description: If specified, number of remaining dialog messages after which caching is skipped.

children.name: vary-by
children.description: A custom expression determined at runtime whose value partitions caching. If multiple vary-by elements are added, values are concatenated to create a unique combination.

policies.name: azure-openai-semantic-cache-store
policies.description: Caches response according to the large language model API cache configuration.

element.name: azure-openai-semantic-cache-store
element.description: Caches response according to the large language model API cache configuration.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Time-to-live of the cached entries, specified in seconds. Policy expressions are allowed.

attributes.name: cache-response
attributes.description: Set to true to cache the current HTTP response. If the attribute is omitted, only HTTP responses with the status code 200 OK are cached. Policy expressions are allowed.

policies.name: azure-openai-token-limit
policies.description: Prevents large language model (LLM) API usage spikes by limiting LLM tokens per calculated key.

element.name: azure-openai-token-limit
element.description: Prevents large language model (LLM) API usage spikes by limiting LLM tokens per calculated key.

attributes.name: counter-key
attributes.description: The key to use for the token limit policy. For each key value, a single counter is used for all scopes at which the policy is configured. Policy expressions are allowed.

attributes.name: tokens-per-minute
attributes.description: The maximum number of tokens consumed by prompt and completion per minute.

attributes.name: token-quota
attributes.description: The maximum number of tokens allowed during the time interval specified in the token-quota-period. Policy expressions are allowed.

attributes.name: token-quota-period
attributes.description: The length of the fixed window after which the token-quota resets. The value must be one of the following: Hourly,Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly. The start time of a quota period is calculated as the UTC timestamp truncated to the unit (hour, day, etc.) used for the period. Policy expressions are allowed.

attributes.name: estimate-prompt-tokens
attributes.description:
Boolean value that determines whether to estimate the number of tokens required for a prompt:
- true: estimate prompt tokens in advance based on prompt schema in API.
- false: don't estimate prompt tokens; use actual token usage from the model response.

For token counting and estimation behavior, see Considerations for token counts and estimation.

attributes.name: retry-after-header-name
attributes.description: The name of a custom response header whose value is the recommended retry interval in seconds after the specified tokens-per-minute or token-quota is exceeded. Policy expressions aren't allowed.

attributes.name: retry-after-variable-name
attributes.description: The name of a variable that stores the recommended retry interval in seconds after the specified tokens-per-minute or token-quota is exceeded. Policy expressions aren't allowed.

attributes.name: remaining-quota-tokens-header-name
attributes.description: The name of a response header whose value after each policy execution is the estimated number of remaining tokens corresponding to token-quota allowed for the token-quota-period. Policy expressions aren't allowed.

attributes.name: remaining-quota-tokens-variable-name
attributes.description: The name of a variable that after each policy execution stores the estimated number of remaining tokens corresponding to token-quota allowed for the token-quota-period. Policy expressions aren't allowed.

attributes.name: remaining-tokens-header-name
attributes.description: The name of a response header whose value after each policy execution is the number of remaining tokens corresponding to tokens-per-minute allowed for the time interval. Policy expressions aren't allowed.

attributes.name: remaining-tokens-variable-name
attributes.description: The name of a variable that after each policy execution stores the number of remaining tokens corresponding to tokens-per-minute allowed for the time interval. Policy expressions aren't allowed.

attributes.name: tokens-consumed-header-name
attributes.description: The name of a response header whose value is the number of tokens consumed by both prompt and completion. The header is added to response only after the response is received from backend. Policy expressions aren't allowed.

attributes.name: tokens-consumed-variable-name
attributes.description: The name of a variable initialized to the estimated prompt token count in the backend section (or zero if estimate-prompt-tokens is false), updated with the actual reported count in the outbound section.
